question: Can examples select and assemble a reusable multi-gate *operation* that is absent as a named operator, using only a fixed universal NAND gate library, and can heldout outcomes be distinguished from irreducible information ambiguity?

frozen_hypothesis.synthesis: A deterministic enumerator of tree programs built exclusively from the three raw input sources and 2-input NAND will find all 256 3-input Boolean truth functions with at most 14 NAND sites. It chooses a minimum-NAND function compatible with five public observations, then physically programs a new numerical NAND threshold circuit. The target operation's identity/full truth table is NEVER passed to synthesis.
frozen_hypothesis.exact_reproduction: For each of all 256 Boolean worlds, the synthesized threshold circuit must reproduce all five observed labels (1280/1280) and agree with independently evaluated selected symbolic NAND program for every 3-bit input (2048/2048), with zero gradient steps in the synthesized circuit.
frozen_hypothesis.information_bound: Across every possible 3-input Boolean function with five fixed publicly observed labels and three hidden labels, a deterministic rule cannot exceed 384/768 hidden correct on uniform exhaustive enumeration. The model, the equally-informed exact symbolic minimum-NAND solver, and an eight-hot fully trained memorization control are expected to tie at exactly 384/768.
frozen_hypothesis.restricted_family: Also report the deterministic minimal-NAND-cost <= 4 subset, using identical five observations, same global candidate space, same source, and no post-outcome tuning. Report coverage and heldout accuracy and the exact trained control accuracy. No frozen scientific superiority claim even if this subset is easier.
frozen_hypothesis.hidden_negative: A counterfactual world that flips all three withheld labels but holds the five public labels identical is information-theoretically indistinguishable. If the original model made C correct guesses then on flipped alternatives it must make 768-C correct (and C wrong); it may not claim OOD recovery.
frozen_hypothesis.structural_negative: Clearing compiled gate-input synaptic connections must change at least one derived output on the set of nontrivial chosen programs, with fully empty circuits always rejected for prediction.
frozen_hypothesis.robustness: Every source-matched numeric circuit checkpoint must cold restore, reject invalid masks/corruption/noncanonical wires; no cross-world state or hidden target labels may leak.

domain.worlds: all 256 Boolean masks, 0..255, no random seeds
domain.budget: Up to 14 two-input NAND nodes in a Boolean expression tree; 3 raw input sources; deterministic minimal-size program per truth mask; ties broken by ascending program fingerprint and candidate mask.
domain.numeric_circuit: All task-specific directed synapse connections and output index initially blank; after an evidence-conditioned NAND synthesis chooses a program, it is compiled into weighted-threshold nodes (two -1 edges with threshold -1 for NAND). Runtime uses numeric weighted sum and threshold only. The source-program selection is an EXTERNAL Python enumerative algorithm, not autonomous numerical neural synthesis. No named XOR, MAJORITY, MUX, or parity operators are supplied to the programming grammar.
domain.canonical_evaluation: Public observations are raw three-bit context plus binary actual outcome; program selection may compute truth masks for library candidates but cannot consult any task-specific hidden label or whole target truth table.

comparator.independent_symbolic: Directly evaluate the chosen NAND expression symbolically without running the numeric circuit, equal information and program prior. Must tie every observed, hidden and full-input selected-program evaluation.
comparator.trained_8hot: A genuine deterministic full-batch Adam fit of 8 independent one-hot feature logits with seed17/no random state, learning rate0.1 and at most 2048 epochs to mean training BCE<=0.02, trained only on five observed examples. Any failure to converge is reportable baseline failure; never reclassify as model advantage. Unknown inputs have zero initial logit and predict 0 (threshold>0.5). The model is not a strongest multi-layer neural control.
comparator.zero_output: Predict zero for all three withheld inputs per world, expected 384/768 on unrestricted cohort.
comparator.no_synthesis: Observed-only associative recall abstains on all withhelds; abstentions counted incorrect on this binary task.
comparator.falsification: All hidden labels flipped, public labels unchanged, test both cohorts and every restored checkpoint.

acceptance.conditional_subset: Report <=4 minimal-NAND subset size/accuracy without retrospective threshold tuning; scientific superiority requires independent stronger matched comparator and whole-process cost, NOT this test.

method.seeds: fully enumerated truth functions; fixed deterministic hash tie-breakers; 8-hot Adam deterministic
method.metrics: NAND gate count, circuit weights, tool/runtime costs, search effort, exact correctness, checkpoints, negative cases, trained-control converged status
method.exclusions: No site-specific ad hoc features, hidden-target checks during search, generic Python truth-table lookup during numeric runtime, paid APIs, external model calls or private scientific first-use.

scientific_limits: Gate primitives and the bounded synthesis search algorithm are PREPROGRAMMED in Python. This constructs previously unnamed compositional operations from observations and compiles them into numeric synapses; it does NOT demonstrate neural discovery of new primitive types, automatic intelligence, data-free learning or compute/energy superiority. The unrestricted 256-world cohort has an information-theoretic 50% hidden limit.
